nowweather.command.auto.done.zh: 已恢复自动同步真实天气。
nowweather.command.auto.done.en: Automatic sync of real weather has been resumed.

nowweather.command.config.ask.asking.zh: [NowWeather] 正在询问 AI…（通常 3~15 秒，可用配置项 %s 个）
nowweather.command.config.ask.asking.en: [NowWeather] Asking the AI… (usually 3-15 seconds, %s config keys available)

nowweather.command.config.ask.disabled.zh: LLM 助手未启用。先执行：/nowweather config set llm.enabled true 并填好 llm.apiKey
nowweather.command.config.ask.disabled.en: The LLM assistant is disabled. Run /nowweather config set llm.enabled true and fill in llm.apiKey first.

nowweather.command.config.ask.edits_disa.zh: 配置里关闭了「允许自然语言改配置」（llm.allowConfigEdits）。
nowweather.command.config.ask.edits_disa.en: Natural-language config edits are turned off in the config (llm.allowConfigEdits).

nowweather.command.config.ask.no_key.zh: 还没填 API Key：/nowweather config set llm.apiKey <你的 key>
nowweather.command.config.ask.no_key.en: No API key set yet: /nowweather config set llm.apiKey <your key>

nowweather.command.config.ask.saved.zh: 已保存并立即生效（%s 项）。

nowweather.command.config.client_only.zh: %s 是客户端配置，只能在客户端的模组设置界面里改。
nowweather.command.config.client_only.en: %s is a client-side option; it can only be changed in the mod's settings screen on the client.

nowweather.command.config.dump.already.zh: 配置目录里已经有气候数据文件了（未覆盖）。位置：%s
nowweather.command.config.dump.already.en: Climate data files already exist in the config directory (nothing was overwritten). Location: %s

nowweather.command.config.dump.done.zh: 已导出 %s 个内置气候数据文件到 %s，可直接编辑。
nowweather.command.config.dump.done.en: Exported %s built-in climate data file(s) to %s — they can be edited directly.

nowweather.command.config.get.unknown.zh: 没有这个配置项：%s（用 /nowweather config list 查看全部）
nowweather.command.config.get.unknown.en: No such config key: %s (use /nowweather config list to see them all)

nowweather.command.config.list.hint.zh: 改法：/nowweather config set <键> <值>　恢复：/nowweather config reset <键>
nowweather.command.config.list.hint.en: To change: /nowweather config set <key> <value>  To restore: /nowweather config reset <key>

nowweather.command.config.reset.done.en: %s has been reset to its default value %s

nowweather.command.config.warn.dimension.zh: 接管的维度列表为空，模组不会驱动任何维度，等效于关闭（默认是 minecraft:overworld）。
nowweather.command.config.warn.dimension.en: The list of managed dimensions is empty, so the mod will not drive any dimension — equivalent to switching it off (the default is minecraft:overworld).

nowweather.command.config.warn.duration.zh: 最短持续（%s 刻）大于最长持续（%s 刻），天气时长会被压到最长值，建议调回来。
nowweather.command.config.warn.duration.en: The minimum duration (%s ticks) is larger than the maximum duration (%s ticks), so weather length will be clamped to the maximum. Consider reverting this.

nowweather.command.config.warn.nether_en.zh: 已允许改写「下界 / 末地」的天气 —— 这不是默认行为，和「这两个维度完全保持原版」的承诺相反。
nowweather.command.config.warn.nether_en.en: The Nether and the End are now allowed to have their weather rewritten — that is not the default, and it contradicts the promise that those two dimensions stay fully vanilla.

nowweather.command.config.warn.stale.zh: 过期判定（%s 秒）小于刷新间隔（%s 秒），数据会在两次刷新之间一直显示为「过期」。
nowweather.command.config.warn.stale.en: The staleness threshold (%s s) is shorter than the refresh interval (%s s), so data will keep showing as stale between refreshes.

nowweather.command.forecast.ai.asking.zh: [NowWeather] 正在请求 AI 推算…
nowweather.command.forecast.ai.asking.en: [NowWeather] Asking the AI for an estimate…

nowweather.command.forecast.ai.budget_no.zh: 每天最多一次；下次可用时间会在 llm.json 里记录。
nowweather.command.forecast.ai.budget_no.en: Once per day at most; the next available time is recorded in llm.json.

nowweather.command.forecast.ai.budget_us.zh: 今天的额度已用完（每天一次，省成本）。还需 %s 小时。
nowweather.command.forecast.ai.budget_us.en: Today's allowance is used up (once a day, to keep costs down). About %s hours to go.

nowweather.command.forecast.ai.daily_dis.zh: 配置里关闭了「每天一次 AI 天气」（llm.weatherDaily）。
nowweather.command.forecast.ai.daily_dis.en: The once-a-day AI weather option is turned off in the config (llm.weatherDaily).

nowweather.command.forecast.ai.disabled.zh: LLM 助手未启用：/nowweather config set llm.enabled true
nowweather.command.forecast.ai.disabled.en: The LLM assistant is disabled: /nowweather config set llm.enabled true

nowweather.command.forecast.ai.no_locati.zh: 还没有地点信息，先让它成功取一次天气。
nowweather.command.forecast.ai.no_locati.en: There is no location yet — let it fetch the weather successfully once first.

nowweather.command.forecast.empty.zh: 还没有预报（需要先有一次成功的真实天气或离线推算）。
nowweather.command.forecast.empty.en: No forecast yet (a successful real-weather fetch or an offline estimate is needed first).

nowweather.command.help.auto.desc.zh: 恢复自动同步真实天气
nowweather.command.help.auto.desc.en: Resume automatic syncing of the real weather

nowweather.command.help.config.desc.zh: 列出全部配置项（同游戏内配置界面）
nowweather.command.help.config.desc.en: List every config option (the same set as the in-game config screen)

nowweather.command.help.config_ask.desc.zh: ★ 用自然语言查询或修改配置（AI 会读取当前配置）
nowweather.command.help.config_ask.desc.en: ★ Query or edit the config in plain language (the AI reads your current config)

nowweather.command.help.config_dump.desc.zh: 把内置气候数据导出到 %s
nowweather.command.help.config_dump.desc.en: Export the built-in climate data to %s

nowweather.command.help.config_get.desc.zh: 查看某一项的当前值、默认值与说明
nowweather.command.help.config_get.desc.en: Show one option's current value, default and description

nowweather.command.help.config_list.desc.zh: 只看某一组，分组名可用 Tab 补全
nowweather.command.help.config_list.desc.en: Show a single section; section names are Tab-completable

nowweather.command.help.config_reload.de.zh: 重新载入数据包或配置里的气候数据
nowweather.command.help.config_reload.de.en: Reload climate data from datapacks and the config directory

nowweather.command.help.config_reset.des.en: Reset one option to its default value

nowweather.command.help.config_set.desc.zh: 改一项并立即生效（走与配置界面相同的范围校验）
nowweather.command.help.config_set.desc.en: Change one option and apply it immediately (same range checks as the config screen)

nowweather.command.help.forecast.desc.zh: 合成预报列表（天气 / 温度 / 置信度 / 是否被气候修正）
nowweather.command.help.forecast.desc.en: Synthesised forecast list (weather / temperature / confidence / climate corrections)

nowweather.command.help.forecast_ai.desc.zh: ★ AI 辅助推算一次天气（每天最多一次）
nowweather.command.help.forecast_ai.desc.en: ★ One AI-assisted weather estimate per day

nowweather.command.help.forecast_sky.des.zh: ★ 真实天色预报：逐小时云量 / 能见度 / 降水概率
nowweather.command.help.forecast_sky.des.en: ★ Real sky forecast: hourly cloud cover / visibility / chance of rain

nowweather.command.help.info_time_sync.d.zh: 同 /nowweather info time（保留的旧写法）
nowweather.command.help.info_time_sync.d.en: Same as /nowweather info time (older spelling, kept for compatibility)

nowweather.command.help.info_weather2_sp.zh: 手动催生一次风暴（验证干预链路）
nowweather.command.help.info_weather2_sp.en: Spawn a storm by hand (to verify the intervention path)

nowweather.command.help.overview.desc.zh: 概览：真实天气 / 本地气候 / 已落地 / 时间
nowweather.command.help.overview.desc.en: Overview: real weather / local climate / what is in effect / time

nowweather.command.help.refresh.desc.zh: 立刻重新拉取真实天气
nowweather.command.help.refresh.desc.en: Fetch the real weather again right now

nowweather.command.help.require_op.zh: 需要 OP 权限（等级 2）。

nowweather.command.help.set.desc.zh: 手动设定天气（暂停自动同步）
nowweather.command.help.set.desc.en: Set the weather by hand (pauses automatic syncing)

nowweather.command.help.test_all.desc.zh: 对所有群系（含超多生物群系）自检
nowweather.command.help.test_all.desc.en: Self-test every biome (including biome mods, which add a great many)

nowweather.command.help.test_biome.desc.zh: 强制用该群系的气候（不带参数则显示当前）
nowweather.command.help.test_biome.desc.en: Force a biome's climate (with no argument, show the current one)

nowweather.command.help.test_clear.desc.zh: 清除强制群系与手动天气，恢复自动同步
nowweather.command.help.test_clear.desc.en: Clear the forced biome and manual weather, and resume automatic syncing

nowweather.command.help.test_matrix.desc.zh: 对该命名空间下全部群系 × 全部天气做一遍自检（默认 minecraft）
nowweather.command.help.test_matrix.desc.en: Self-test every biome × every weather type in that namespace (default: minecraft)

nowweather.command.help.test_weather.des.zh: 强制灌入一次该天气并立即重算落地
nowweather.command.help.test_weather.des.en: Force-feed one weather type and immediately recompute what lands in the world

nowweather.command.help.usage.zh: 用法：/nowweather <子命令>，所有参数都可以用 Tab 补全。
nowweather.command.help.usage.en: Usage: /nowweather <subcommand>; every argument supports Tab completion.

nowweather.command.info.acoustics.advice.zh: ★ 这些是「建议值」，尚未写回 —— 它的参数是全局预设，需要它按 sup_mods/SoundPhysicsRemastered_change.log 暴露接口。
nowweather.command.info.acoustics.advice.en: ★ These are suggestions only and have not been written back — its reverb settings are global presets, and it would need to expose an API as noted in sup_mods/SoundPhysicsRemastered_change.log.

nowweather.command.info.acoustics.input_.zh: 默认值（还没有真实天气）

nowweather.command.info.acoustics.not_in.zh: 装上 Sound Physics Remastered 后这里会给出实际的混响建议值。
nowweather.command.info.acoustics.not_in.en: Install Sound Physics Remastered and this will show concrete reverb suggestions.

nowweather.command.info.acoustics.read_f.zh: 读不到它的混响参数（版本签名不同？）
nowweather.command.info.acoustics.read_f.en: Could not read its reverb settings (different method signatures in this version?)

nowweather.command.info.biome.no_facts.zh: 取不到生物群系信息（请站在世界里再执行，或站在无群系的位置）。
nowweather.command.info.biome.no_facts.en: Could not read the biome information (run this while standing in the world; you may also be standing somewhere with no biome).

nowweather.command.info.cache.disabled.zh: 缓存未启用（平台没有提供缓存目录）。
nowweather.command.info.cache.disabled.en: Caching is off (the platform did not provide a cache directory).

nowweather.command.info.cache.field.cach.zh: 缓存实况: %s %s°C（%s 分钟前，来源 %s）

nowweather.command.info.cache.field.coor.zh: · 坐标: %s  海拔: %s  气候带: %s

nowweather.command.info.llm.field.daily.zh: 每日一次 AI 天气: %s，剩余额度: %s

nowweather.command.info.llm.nl_allowed.zh: 允许（白名单 + 范围校验）

nowweather.command.info.llm.usage.zh: 用法：/nowweather config ask <一句话>　/nowweather forecast ai
nowweather.command.info.llm.usage.en: Usage: /nowweather config ask <a sentence>  /nowweather forecast ai

nowweather.command.info.offline.note.zh: （这只是演示，不会改变游戏里的天气）
nowweather.command.info.offline.note.en: (This is only a demo; it does not change the weather in game)

nowweather.command.info.providers.extens.zh: 可用扩展点：WeatherProvider（入）/ WeatherBinding（出）/ ClimateResolver（气候覆盖）
nowweather.command.info.providers.extens.en: Extension points: WeatherProvider (input) / WeatherBinding (output) / ClimateResolver (climate override)

nowweather.command.info.shaders.adaptati.zh: 适配补丁见仓库 shaders/nowweather-adaptation/（配套 iterationT 3.2.0：NW_CLOUD_BAND = 0.60、NW_RAIN_THRESHOLD = 0.75，与 core 的 SkyMood.CLOUD_BAND_MAX / RAIN_BAND_MIN 一致）。
nowweather.command.info.shaders.adaptati.en: The adaptation patch lives in the repository at shaders/nowweather-adaptation/ (built for iterationT 3.2.0: NW_CLOUD_BAND = 0.60 and NW_RAIN_THRESHOLD = 0.75, matching SkyMood.CLOUD_BAND_MAX / RAIN_BAND_MIN in core).

nowweather.command.info.shaders.can_cont.zh: 模组能控（通过写 rainLevel，光影读 rainStrength 这一条通道）：
nowweather.command.info.shaders.can_cont.en: What the mod can control (through the one channel where we write rainLevel and shaders read rainStrength):
cloud cover, cloud shadows, sky brightness

nowweather.command.info.shaders.can_cont.zh: 、雨/雷强度、湿地、太阳月亮角度、月相、闪电位置
nowweather.command.info.shaders.can_cont.en: , rain/thunder intensity, wetness, sun and moon angles, moon phase, lightning position

nowweather.command.info.shaders.encoding.en: 0.60 ~ 0.75  → buffer zone, never written by the mod
0.00 ~ 0.60  → cloud cover (0 = clear, 0.60 = fully overcast; cloudy and overcast skies go here)

nowweather.command.info.shaders.encoding.zh: rainStrength 是「云量 + 降水」共用的一条通道，按区间编码：
nowweather.command.info.shaders.encoding.en: rainStrength is one channel shared by cloud cover and precipitation, split into bands:

nowweather.command.info.shaders.need_pac.zh: ★ 其中「云量 / 云影 / 天色」需要光影包装了 NowWeather 适配。
nowweather.command.info.shaders.need_pac.en: ★ Cloud cover, cloud shadows and sky colour only work if the shader pack ships NowWeather support.

nowweather.command.info.shaders.pack_una.zh: 未适配的光影包只认 wetness：分不出「阴天」和「下雨」，云量也只是全晴或全雨两档。
nowweather.command.info.shaders.pack_una.en: Shader packs without the adaptation only understand wetness: they cannot tell an overcast sky from rain, and cloud cover collapses to all-clear or all-rain.

nowweather.command.info.shaders.rain_sup.zh: 已被接管（当前无降水，避免阴天画雨）
nowweather.command.info.shaders.rain_sup.en: taken over (there is no precipitation right now, so an overcast sky does not render rain)

nowweather.command.info.shaders.rain_van.zh: 交给原版（降水照常显示）
nowweather.command.info.shaders.rain_van.en: left to vanilla (precipitation renders as usual)

nowweather.command.info.shaders.uniform..zh: ← 云量 / 降水共用这一条通道，按区间编码（见下）
nowweather.command.info.shaders.uniform..en: ← one channel shared by cloud cover and precipitation, band-encoded (see below)

nowweather.command.info.shaders.uniform..zh: （由光影自己按 wetnessHalfLife 平滑；未适配的光影包会把云量区间也当成「湿了」，这正是需要适配补丁的原因）
nowweather.command.info.shaders.uniform..en: (the shader pack smooths it with its own wetnessHalfLife; without the adaptation patch a pack also treats the cloud-cover band as wet, which is exactly why the patch exists)

nowweather.command.info.shaders.uniform_.zh: ★ 我们正在喂给光影的 uniform：
nowweather.command.info.shaders.uniform_.en: ★ Uniforms we are feeding the shader:

nowweather.command.info.shaders.why.zh:
（Iris / OptiFine 没有给第三方模组注入 uniform 的 API，
   所以联动只能走上面那条「模组写 rainLevel」的通道。）
nowweather.command.info.shaders.why.en:
(Iris and OptiFine give third-party mods no API for injecting uniforms,
   so this one channel — the mod writing rainLevel — is all we have.)

nowweather.command.info.sky.field.curren.zh: 当前真实云量: %s%%，能见度: %s km
nowweather.command.info.sky.field.curren.en: Current real cloud cover: %s%%, visibility: %s km

nowweather.command.info.sky.field.layers.zh: 低云 %s%% / 中云 %s%% / 高云 %s%%
nowweather.command.info.sky.field.layers.en: Low cloud %s%% / mid cloud %s%% / high cloud %s%%

nowweather.command.info.sky.footer.zh: 天色由真实云量 + 能见度驱动：云越多越阴沉，能见度越低雾越近。
nowweather.command.info.sky.footer.en: Sky colour follows real cloud cover and visibility: more cloud means a gloomier sky, and lower visibility means the fog closing in.

nowweather.command.info.sky.header.zh: ===== 真实天色预报（未来 12 小时）=====

nowweather.command.info.sky.hour_line.zh: %s  云 %s%%  能见度 %s km  降水 %s mm/%s%%

nowweather.command.info.sky.requirement.zh: 天色预报需要：① Open-Meteo 可达；② 有坐标（可先靠 UApiPro 的 IP 定位填上）。
nowweather.command.info.sky.requirement.en: The sky forecast needs: (1) Open-Meteo reachable; (2) coordinates (UApiPro's IP location can fill those in for you).

nowweather.command.info.terrain.elevatio.zh: 海拔未知（按 0 米处理）

nowweather.command.info.terrain.field.po.zh: 采样位置: %s, %s, %s（y=%s 对应 0 米）

nowweather.command.info.terrain.hint.zh: 开关：/nowweather config set mapping.terrainTransfer false

nowweather.command.info.terrain.no_chang.zh: 无需订正（高差可忽略或地形中性）
nowweather.command.info.terrain.no_chang.en: no adjustment needed (the elevation difference is negligible, or the terrain is neutral)

nowweather.command.info.terrain.no_weath.zh: 还没有真实天气数据，无法演示订正结果。
nowweather.command.info.terrain.no_weath.en: There is no real weather data yet, so the adjustment result cannot be shown.

nowweather.command.info.terrain.value.zh: %s°C 湿度%s%% 气压%s hPa 风 %s 级

nowweather.command.info.terrain.value_wi.zh: %s°C 湿度%s%% 气压%s hPa 风 %s 级 %s

nowweather.command.info.time.target_note.zh: （真实 %s 应对应游戏内 %s 点）

nowweather.command.info.usage_hint.zh: 用法：/nowweather info <主题>，例如 /nowweather info biome

nowweather.command.info.weather2.note.zh:
说明：桥接与干预都用反射调用它的真实方法（无公开 API 包）；失败时静默降级。
手动验证：/nowweather info weather2 spawn SANDSTORM
nowweather.command.info.weather2.note.en:
Note: the bridge and the intervention call its real methods by reflection (it ships no public API package); failures degrade silently.
Manual check: /nowweather info weather2 spawn SANDSTORM

nowweather.command.info.weather2.spawn.u.zh: 只支持 SANDSTORM 或 SNOWSTORM。
nowweather.command.info.weather2.spawn.u.en: Only SANDSTORM or SNOWSTORM are supported.

nowweather.command.info.weather2.storm_l.zh: 距 %s 格  尺寸 %s  强度 %s%%

nowweather.command.info.weather2.yield_o.zh: 开（检测到就只提供数据）
nowweather.command.info.weather2.yield_o.en: on (when another mod is detected, we only supply data)

nowweather.command.overview.real_weather.zh: 真实天气 暂无数据

nowweather.command.overview.time.zh: 时间 %s → 游戏内 %s 点

nowweather.command.refresh.done.zh: 已请求刷新真实天气（结果会在几秒内出现在 /nowweather status 里）。
nowweather.command.refresh.done.en: Requested a real-weather refresh (the result shows up in /nowweather status within a few seconds).

nowweather.command.set.done.zh: 已手动设定为「%s」，自动同步已暂停（用 /nowweather auto 恢复）。
nowweather.command.set.done.en: Weather set manually to %s; automatic syncing is paused (use /nowweather auto to resume).

nowweather.command.set.unknown.zh: 无法识别的天气：%s。用 Tab 补全查看可用值。
nowweather.command.set.unknown.en: Unrecognised weather: %s. Press Tab to see the accepted values.

nowweather.command.test.biome.none.zh: 当前未强制指定群系（按玩家所在群系自动判断）。
nowweather.command.test.biome.none.en: No biome is forced right now (the player's own biome is used).

nowweather.command.test.biome.set.zh:
已强制使用群系气候：%s
  正常温度范围 %s，可能出现 %s
nowweather.command.test.biome.set.en:
Forced biome climate: %s
  normal temperature range %s, may see %s

nowweather.command.test.clear.done.zh: 已清除强制群系与手动天气，恢复自动同步。
nowweather.command.test.clear.done.en: Cleared the forced biome and the manual weather; automatic syncing resumed.

nowweather.command.test.matrix.no_biomes.zh: 没有匹配的群系（命名空间：%s）。

nowweather.command.test.matrix.summary.zh:
===== NowWeather 自检报告 =====
群系 %s 个 × 天气 %s 种 = %s 个用例（维度 %s）
写入并按回读校验成功：%s
写入失败/回读不一致：%s
天气越出白名单：%s
温度越界：%s
天气未被修正（本就合理）：%s
按配置保持原版（下界/末地/虚空，未做校验）：%s
违规类型统计：%s
nowweather.command.test.matrix.summary.en:
===== NowWeather self-test report =====
%s biomes × %s weather types = %s cases (dimension %s)
Written and verified by read-back: %s
Write failures / read-back mismatches: %s
Weather outside the allowlist: %s
Temperature out of range: %s
Weather left uncorrected (already plausible): %s
Kept vanilla by config (Nether / End / void, not checked): %s
Violation types: %s

nowweather.command.test.weather.done.zh:
灌入 %s / %s°C（群系：%s）
  决策：%s
  温度：%s°C → %s°C
  落地：%s
nowweather.command.test.weather.done.en:
Fed in %s at %s°C (biome: %s)
  Decision: %s
  Temperature: %s°C → %s°C
  Landed: %s

nowweather.command.test.weather.landing_.zh: 回读不一致：期望 %s，实际 %s；目标群系 %s 的正常温度范围 %s，本例决策温度 %s°C
nowweather.command.test.weather.landing_.en: Read-back mismatch: expected %s, got %s; the target biome %s has a normal temperature range of %s, and this case decided on %s°C

nowweather.command.test.weather.landing_.zh: 未写入（未指定群系 → 跳过气候校验与落地验证；先执行 /nowweather test biome <群系ID> 再灌天气）
nowweather.command.test.weather.landing_.en: not written (no biome set, so climate checks and landing verification were skipped; run /nowweather test biome <biome id> before feeding weather)

nowweather.command.info.shaders.derive.h.zh: ★ 天色推导（判断天色是否正常的依据）：
nowweather.command.info.shaders.derive.h.en: ★ Sky derivation (this is what you check the sky against):

nowweather.command.info.shaders.derive.c.zh: 未知（没有云量数据，天色不会跟随）
nowweather.command.info.shaders.derive.c.en: unknown (no cloud data, so the sky will not follow)

nowweather.command.info.shaders.derive.r.zh: 写入 rainLevel= %s（= 云量 × cloudRainScale %s）

nowweather.command.info.shaders.derive.b.zh: 光影解出云量  = %s（= rainLevel ÷ NW_CLOUD_BAND 0.60）
天色亮度      = %s（= 1 − 云量 × NW_CLOUD_DIM 0.45）

nowweather.command.info.shaders.derive.n.zh: （云量或写入值缺失，天色暂不跟随真实天气）
nowweather.command.info.shaders.derive.n.en: (cloud cover or the written value is missing, so the sky does not follow yet)
